body: Anyone want to pick up where @laegrim left of?
Or @laegrim do you want to work on this? We should fix this within the next week / couple days.
@amueller can you please give some background on it?

Hi, I hope I understood it right. AFAICU the `partial_fit` method when called on mini batches is binarizing the output for every call instead of using the same list of classes given for the first time. So, the binarizing logic should be done only if the `classes` is not set for batch learning and if once set( the first time) classes should be reused from the next time. Hope it helps.
@vineelyalamarthy you can work on it, but this is something I'd really like to have fixed quite soon (within the next week)
